title: Schedule of Benefits: Trip Cancellation and Trip Interruption, Trip Protection Plans
content:
Trip Protection, underwritten by Harbor Mutual Travel Insurance Company, measures its trip cancellation and trip interruption benefits by the percentages and amounts in this schedule. The schedule applies plan by plan; a policy takes the figures of the plan it was bought on.

## Benefit percentages and return travel

| Plan | Trip cancellation (percent of the non-refunded insured cost) | Trip interruption (percent of the non-refunded unused insured cost) | Return travel on an interruption, most paid (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Cancellation Only | 100.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Trip Protection Essential | 100.00 | 100.00 | 500.00 |
| Trip Protection Standard | 100.00 | 125.00 | 750.00 |
| Trip Protection Plus | 100.00 | 150.00 | 1000.00 |
| Trip Protection Premier | 100.00 | 150.00 | 1500.00 |
| Trip Protection Premier CFAR | 100.00 | 150.00 | 1500.00 |

## Bases common to every plan

The following bases are the same on all six plans.

| Term | Wording on every plan |
|---|---|
| What cancellation benefits are measured on | prepaid amounts of the stay that Roamhaven did not refund |
| Which nights count as unused on an interruption | prepaid nights dated on or after the interruption date |
| How Roamhaven refunds and plan benefits fit together | the plan pays only what Roamhaven did not refund; a later Roamhaven refund of the same amounts is recovered from the guest |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The trip cancellation percentage is applied to the non-refunded insured cost of the stay; on every plan it is 100.00 percent.
2. The trip interruption percentage is applied to the non-refunded unused insured cost, and the unused nights are the prepaid nights dated on or after the interruption date. A night dated the day before the interruption date is not unused; a night dated on the interruption date is.
3. The return travel figure is the most paid toward return travel on an interruption.
4. Trip Cancellation Only shows 0.00 for trip interruption and for return travel.

## Illustration on hypothetical dates

A stay has prepaid nights dated the 4th through the 9th of a month, and the interruption date is the 7th. The nights dated the 7th, 8th and 9th count as unused; the nights dated the 4th, 5th and 6th do not.
